full_prompt_en: A square watercolor and graphite fantasy landscape presents a vast pale stone city rising from a rocky cliff. Domes, slender towers, layered terraces, arches, and bridges climb toward the upper right, each drawn with delicate structural lines that stay visible through translucent paint. At the left, a dark vertical drop and a wide waterfall descend beside the masonry into the lower foreground. The buildings seem carved into the cliff rather than simply placed on it. Cool blue-gray rock, soft cream stone, and muted slate shadows form a restrained palette. A veil of mist partially hides the lower levels and softens the far structures; the sky is a pale quiet wash with little detail. Fine pencil hatching picks out ledges, windows, parapets, and crevices, while broader wet washes model water and distance. The composition moves from rough dark rock at lower left toward the luminous dome and adjoining towers at upper right. Narrow bridges and curved roofs add rhythm between large cliff masses. The image feels old, remote, and intricately imagined, yet the surface stays airy and delicate. Paper grain appears through the thin pigments. Light is diffuse and cool, with subtle warmer cream on exposed stone. There is no lettering, heavy ink outline, or hard photographic contrast.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形水彩与石墨奇幻风景描绘庞大的浅色石城从岩崖上升起。穹顶、细塔、层叠平台、拱券与桥梁一路攀向右上方，每处都有精细结构线，并透过半透明颜料保持可见。左侧深色垂直落差旁，一条宽瀑布沿砌石坠向下方前景。建筑仿佛从峭壁中凿出，而非简单安放其上。冷蓝灰岩石、柔和奶油色石材和低调板岩暗影构成节制调色。薄雾部分遮住下层，也软化远处构造；天空只是浅淡安静的洗色，细节很少。细铅笔排线勾出平台边、窗、女儿墙和岩缝，较宽湿洗色则塑造水流与距离。构图从左下粗暗岩壁移向右上明亮穹顶和相邻尖塔。窄桥与弧形屋顶在大块崖体之间带来节奏。画面古老、遥远、想象细密，表面却依然轻盈精巧。薄颜料中透出纸纹。光线漫射而冷，暴露的石面有微弱暖奶油色。没有字样、沉重墨线或强烈摄影反差。
style_prompt_en: Delicate graphite drawing under transparent watercolor washes, with finely hatched edges, intricate layered forms, and visible textured paper. Cool slate and blue-gray shadows balance pale cream highlights. Diffuse mist softens distant planes and lets precise foreground lines fade gradually into broad wet washes. The composition rises through interlocking vertical and curved rhythms, remaining airy, antiquated, and quietly luminous.
style_prompt_zh: 精巧石墨线稿覆以透明水彩洗色，细密排线边缘、复杂层叠形体和可见纹理纸面并存。冷板岩与蓝灰暗影平衡浅奶油色高光。漫射薄雾软化远层，使精准前景线条逐渐退入宽阔湿洗色。构图借相扣的竖向和弧形节奏上升，保持轻盈、古旧与安静发光感。
theme_en: A pale cliffside city above a misted waterfall
theme_zh: 薄雾瀑布上方的浅色崖城
name: Alan Lee
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
